title: Kyiv offensive
summary: The term 'Kyiv offensive' refers to two significant military campaigns in [[history-of-ukraine|Ukrainian history]], specifically during the Polish–Soviet War in 1920 and as part of the Russian invasion of Ukraine in 2022.

sections.heading: Kyiv Offensive (1920)
paragraphs: The Kyiv offensive of 1920 was a military campaign that occurred during the Polish–Soviet War, which had a profound impact on the territorial and political landscape of [[ukraine|Ukraine]].

sections.heading: Kyiv Offensive (2022)
paragraphs: The Kyiv offensive in 2022 was a crucial phase of the Northern front during the Russian [[full-scale-russo-ukrainian-war|invasion of Ukraine]], highlighting the ongoing conflict and its implications for [[ukrainian|Ukrainian]] sovereignty.
